issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but both the template and the solution declare this helper as private (and the template currently has the parameter commented out). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the required API and may prevent external tests from accessing the helper method as the statement requests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method public and include the Animal parameter in the signature as specified: public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). Update both the template Farm.java stub and the solution implementation to use public visibility so the implementation matches the problem statement and is accessible for testing.
